11: atx heading start: 1-6 hashes then space/tab run or one line end
12: setext heading line: a run of = or - , spaces/tabs, one line end; length includes the line end
13: open code fence: 3+ backticks or tildes; length is the fence only; line end required after the info
14: close code fence: 3+ backticks or tildes, then only spaces/tabs up to a line end
15: html block start (types 1-6): the length matched, not a type code; every spec tag name
16: html block start 7: a complete open/close tag then spaces and a line end; length includes the line end
17: html block end 1-5: greedy to the last terminator on the line; never past a newline
18: spacechars: the run of space, tab, VT, FF, CR, LF; 0 when none
19: scheme: a letter then 1-31 of letters, digits, + . - and a colon; length includes the colon
20: autolink uri (scanned after the '<'): scheme, no space/control/</>, then '>'; length includes '>'
21: autolink email (scanned after the '<'): local part, @, hostname labels, '>'
22: html tag, open and close tags (scanned after the '<')
23: html comment, processing instruction, declaration, cdata (scanned after the '<')
24: link title: quoted by " ' or ( ), escapes, ambiguous closers; length includes the delimiters
25: dangerous url: javascript: vbscript: file: data: (not data:image/png|gif|jpeg|webp); length of the scheme and colon
26: every scanner: no match on an empty base and at the very end of a base
